evidence_level: revealed development cross-validation; no calibration or test access
objective: Predict whether ROI-512 improves task utility over ROI-384 using only low-cost deployable image and prompt-category features.
allowed_features: category explicitly present in the task prompt
source width, height, aspect ratio and pixel count
64x64 RGB mean, standard deviation and histograms
64x64 luminance quantiles, gradients, edge fractions and 4x4 pooled statistics
forbidden_features: target area, edge, overlap or scene-complexity stratification labels
high-resolution action output at decision time

model.type: ridge regression on continuous utility gain

gate.noninferiority_rule: paired 95% bootstrap lower bound must be at or above the margin

failure_interpretation: Cheap global statistics are insufficient; this does not reject a learned visual scout or reusable encoder features.
